title: GString headers component diagram
description: The reconstructed GString headers, one per piece of the library, and what each includes or names. They declare an interface and implement none of it, so every relationship is an #include or a type a declaration names, never a call. all.hpp is the one to include. The foreign string libraries are forward-declared in gconfig.hpp, not included; the Windows headers are included only on Windows.

components.name: GString, reconstructed
components.responsibility: A speculative, header-only declaration of GString, in the C++98 and Win32 of 1999; implemented nowhere, and never part of a program that ran.

components.name: Umbrella header (all.hpp)
components.responsibility: Includes every other header, in order. The one to include.

components.name: Platform and basic types (gconfig.hpp)
components.responsibility: Refuses anything but Windows with #error unless GSTRING_SYNTAX_CHECK is defined; the GSTRING_API export macro; GByte, GUnit16, GCodePoint, GLength and GHash; forward declarations of the foreign string classes.

components.name: Encodings (gencoding.hpp)
components.responsibility: GEncoding::Type, the encoding every narrow string and every conversion names, and GCodePage.

components.name: Forward declarations (gfwd.hpp)
components.responsibility: Names every class and struct, and the GStrings and GSubStrings vectors.

components.name: Payload and body (gpayload.hpp)
components.responsibility: GPayload, a native string with its carrier, encoding and ownership; GBody, the copy-on-write body with the cached length and hashes and the generation; GSurvivor, which payload two equal strings keep.

components.name: Format arguments (gformat.hpp)
components.responsibility: GFormatArg, one typed argument to GString::Format.

components.name: GString (gstring.hpp)
components.responsibility: The string class and its whole catalogue of methods: making, asking, finding, taking pieces, changing, case, splitting, comparing, escaping, converting and walking.

components.name: GSpot (gspot.hpp)
components.responsibility: A position in a GString, stepping by character, code unit or byte, that finds its place again when the body's payload is replaced.

components.name: GSubString (gsubstring.hpp)
components.responsibility: A piece of a GString that holds the original and two GSpots instead of copying; Detach copies it.

components.name: GStringList (gstringlist.hpp)
components.responsibility: The pieces of a + b + c, not yet joined; Flatten joins them into one payload.

components.name: GTokeniser (gtokeniser.hpp)
components.responsibility: Lazy splitting into GSubStrings, at whitespace, a set of separators or a regular expression.

components.name: GRegularExpression (gregularexpression.hpp)
components.responsibility: GRegularExpression, its dialects and options, and GMatch, whose outcome may be TooAmbitious when the backtracking budget runs out.

components.name: Windows headers (windows.h, oleauto.h)
components.responsibility: The Win32 API and BSTR; included by gconfig.hpp only when _WIN32 is defined.

components.name: C++ standard library
components.responsibility: std::string, std::wstring and std::vector, with <stddef.h> and <time.h>.

components.name: Rogue Wave strings (RWCString, RWWString)
components.responsibility: Foreign string classes GString converts from and to; declared in gconfig.hpp, never included.

components.name: MFC (CString)
components.responsibility: A foreign string class GString converts from and to; declared in gconfig.hpp, never included.

components.name: COM string wrappers (_bstr_t, CComBSTR)
components.responsibility: The compiler's and ATL's BSTR wrappers, which GString can be made from; declared in gconfig.hpp, never included.
